item.title: Putting survivors at the centre of gender-based violence services
item.description: Reaching out for help can be an enormous step for survivors of gender-based violence (GBV), and what happens after walking through the doors of a support service can shape the path towards recovery and safety

item.title: 16 Days of Activism: UNHCR warns over deep funding cuts to vital protection work
item.description: Serious funding cuts are severely weakening protection for refugee and stateless women and girls and others at risk of gender-based violence (GBV), like Mariam, who survived a decade of captivity and rape at the hands of Boko Haram militia.
